name: Korean
modelReview: artifacts written 2026-11-13 by Claude Fable 5.2 from usage notes written in Korean with no knowledge of cron: answers, lexicon and hand-written paradigm rows, read that day twice against their patterns and four times by blind fluency readers, with five author passes; parked. 2026-11-19, by Claude Fable 5.2: revised for the rewritten CLAUDE.md, the core's calendar facts and the last reads' open findings. Bare rhythms from the first hour («2시간마다», «6시간마다»); hours at a step over a finer rhythm as a burst («2시간마다 1시간 동안 15분 간격으로») with no bracket of sample times; no count-and-bracket for seconds; exceptions only of listed values; a step of days from its start («매월 1일부터 3일마다»); the date itself where a count from the month's end comes to one day; «윤년마다»; both-must-match days («매월 홀수일 중 월요일인 날»). Every changed row was worked against its pattern by the author. That pass was read the same day by a blind judge briefed only in Korean (84 sentences, every reading of each) and by a schedule reader (all 696 rows against their patterns): no wrong time, and second readings in the burst («1시간 동안 15분 간격으로»: the end of the length counted as a firing), in «1일부터 5일 간격으로», in a trailing «부터», a bare stray minute, «해당 연도» and a union with an exception. Second pass, same day: no length is said anywhere; hours at a step are a frame of whole hours («0시대부터 오후 10시대까지 2시간 간격으로 각각 15분마다») and minutes a frame for seconds («…15분 간격으로 각각 0·30초»); «1일부터 시작해 5일 간격으로»; «이들 해에는»; four hours are a rhythm whatever the minute. No renderer built; the forms of the second pass have had no independent read
